why: The store labels every article of labour-disputes as version law-90-04; to confirm whether Law 91-28 (or any later law) amended articles 19, 24, 26 to 37 and from what date, so that the wording cited is the one in force.

article: prior recourse in social security disputes
why: Boundary n2 separates social security disputes (also before the social section) from individual labour disputes; to read their own prior recourse before writing anything on it.

article: definition of a collective labour dispute
why: Boundary n3 separates collective disputes from individual ones; it rests on article 2 of Law 90-04 only.
